title: Websites
description: One row per website in the input, with the technologies found on it and the evidence for each.

input.description: The website as it was given in the input.

url.description: The address that was requested first.

finalUrl.description: The address of the page that was read, after redirects.

status.description: analyzed, blocked, robots_disallowed, unreachable, http_error, not_html, invalid or error. Only websites with the status analyzed are charged.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code of the page.

message.description: Why the website was not analyzed, in plain words. Empty for analyzed websites.

language.description: Language the page declares, for example en.

technologyCount.description: Number of technologies found on the website. Services that only appear in DNS records are not counted.

technologyList.description: All technologies found, separated by semicolons, the most telling categories first.

cms.description: Content management system, for example WordPress or Drupal. Several values are separated by semicolons.

ecommerce.description: Ecommerce platform, for example Shopify or WooCommerce. Several values are separated by semicolons.

websiteBuilder.description: Website builder, for example Wix, Squarespace or Webflow. Several values are separated by semicolons.

frameworks.description: JavaScript and web frameworks, for example Next.js or React. Several values are separated by semicolons.

analytics.description: Analytics tools, for example Google Analytics or Matomo. Several values are separated by semicolons.

tagManagers.description: Tag managers, for example Google Tag Manager. Several values are separated by semicolons.

advertising.description: Advertising pixels and tags, for example Meta Pixel or Google Ads. Several values are separated by semicolons.

marketing.description: Marketing automation, CRM and email marketing tools, for example HubSpot or Klaviyo. Several values are separated by semicolons.

liveChat.description: Live chat and support tools, for example Intercom or Zendesk. Several values are separated by semicolons.

payments.description: Payment providers, for example Stripe or PayPal. Several values are separated by semicolons.

cookieConsent.description: Cookie consent tools, for example OneTrust or Cookiebot. Several values are separated by semicolons.

hosting.description: Hosting providers and CDNs, for example Cloudflare or Vercel. Several values are separated by semicolons.

emailProvider.description: Where the domain receives its email, from its MX records, for example Google Workspace.

dnsProvider.description: DNS provider or providers of the domain, from its name servers. Several values are separated by semicolons.

emailSenders.description: Services allowed to send email for the domain, from its SPF record. Several values are separated by semicolons.

connectedServices.description: Services the domain has been verified with, from its TXT records. Several values are separated by semicolons.

technologyNames.description: Names of all technologies found on the website.

technologies.description: Every technology with its category, its version when the page shows one, and the evidence it was recognised by.

category.description: Category of the technology, for example CMS or Analytics.

version.description: Version, when the page shows it.

evidence.description: Signals the technology was recognised by, for example a header, a cookie name or a script address.

wordpress.description: On WordPress websites: the theme and the plugin folders that the page loads.

dns.description: What the domain's public DNS records show: email provider, mail servers, DNS provider, name servers, SPF senders, DMARC policy and connected services.

redirectCount.description: Number of redirects followed before the page was read.

responseTimeMs.description: Time the page took to answer, in milliseconds.

checkedAt.description: When the website was checked, in UTC (ISO 8601).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One column per kind of technology: CMS, ecommerce, frameworks, analytics, advertising, marketing, chat, payments, hosting and email provider.

technologies.title: All technologies
technologies.description: The full technology list of every website, with the page title and language.

domain.title: Email and DNS
domain.description: What the domain's DNS records show: email provider, email sending services, DNS provider and connected services.

status.title: Status
status.description: Which websites were analyzed and why the others were not, with HTTP status, redirects and response time.
